answer: Each new agent identity must lock a fixed stake in a protocol vault that only unlocks after several epoch delays. Fake accounts cannot share one deposit: every identity has its own lock, so standing up N graders costs N stakes plus the time-value of capital stuck in those locks. The delay is deliberate, like groundwater moving through karst, to stop an attacker from recycling the same purse after a slash. Detected self-grading rings forfeit the vault, so the cost delta of a farm is lost principal, not just a temporary pause.
